notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 31 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer31232cont), the 28 weekly issues from 4 July 1931 to 9 January 1932, the last the Internet Archive holds. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1930-1934, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before the year of the record. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 80 of the 100 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates are set from the 28 cover pages, one week apart from 4 July (26 covers read; the 18 July and 15 August starts are placed between the running heads of their neighbours). Permits whose heading counts more than one dwelling were set aside before the image check and sit with the held single houses; one more was caught at the image.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26 to 31 read (January 1926 to January 1932), which is the end of the run; the 22 half-year volumes before 1926 (1915 to 1925) are unread, vol. 25 part 2 (July-December 1925, buildingengineer2525cont) next. In this volume: 216 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, single houses with no architect named and no page (15 of them permits for a row of houses), wait on a decision about how many pages to seed (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 245 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 493 rows were not placed, most of them location lines not parsed (248: tract lots, garbled headings), street pairs that do not cross under the names read (92) and printed street numbers with no EAS row today (152).
coverage.note: 1,542 numbered entries read, 1,054 San Francisco rows, 561 placed on a parcel, 100 picked and read against the page image, 92 published on 90 pages (42 seeded), 8 held back: four uses that contradict the roll, one same-issue contract placed on the neighbouring lot, one permit for two houses, and two parcels with no address row.
